description: Contract cases, not execution results. QA worker must implement actual tests and replace not-run statuses only with evidence.

cases.scenario: Incomplete defun remains in editor; complete form submits only on explicit valid boundary
cases.oracle: editor state transitions and source equality

cases.scenario: Nested quasiquote, strings, comments, escaped delimiters do not break multiline detection
cases.oracle: reader-aware completeness regression

cases.scenario: Wide glyph, combining marks, emoji and cursor vertical movement use display-cell coordinates
cases.oracle: assert expected row and screen column

cases.scenario: Undo, yank and history navigation never lose unsent draft
cases.oracle: state snapshot before and after navigation

cases.scenario: Multiline pasted input with embedded tabs/newlines remains unchanged and never triggers unexpected EVAL
cases.oracle: capture buffer and request count

cases.scenario: Defparameter and defun persist across independently scheduled evaluations
cases.oracle: subsequent source reads earlier definitions

cases.scenario: In-package persists while unrelated worker context does not leak
cases.oracle: current package assertions

cases.scenario: Multiple values are returned with CL REPL history variables preserved
cases.oracle: ordered typed value events

cases.scenario: stdout, stderr and nonlocal conditions captured without terminal side effects
cases.oracle: tagged event order and no unsolicited writes

cases.scenario: Cancel pending/running EVAL, then execute next expression without stale output overwriting UI
cases.oracle: request IDs, bounded completion and late-result rejection

cases.scenario: Long-running evaluation does not freeze keystrokes or prevent user-visible cancel
cases.oracle: bounded Ctrl+C response with documented limitations

cases.scenario: Incomplete source, package qualification and reader strings/comments safely produce candidates or empty result
cases.oracle: candidate insertion spans and no eval side effects

cases.scenario: Candidate ranking and selection changes use stable identity and generation
cases.oracle: deterministic ordering

cases.scenario: Out-of-order async results and stale doc timers are ignored
cases.oracle: generation and cancellable dwell assertions

cases.scenario: Popup appears above cursor when room available and flips below at top edge
cases.oracle: actual PTY screenshot cursor row vs menu bounding box

cases.scenario: Selected item documentation appears after dwell and disappears on selection change
cases.oracle: timed PTY before/after captures with unchanged editor latency

cases.scenario: Package list and ASDF systems read without loading arbitrary systems
cases.oracle: stable snapshot and read-only behavior

cases.scenario: Bound specials, unbound symbols and symbol descriptions are represented correctly
cases.oracle: structured snapshots, no guessed lexical locals

cases.scenario: Cyclic values and printable custom objects have strict depth/length/time bounds
cases.oracle: bounded output; no runaway traversal

cases.scenario: After EVAL changes variable value, UI inspector updates without stealing focus
cases.oracle: both panel captures and cursor ownership

cases.scenario: Local workbench loads without Slynk; optional remote adapter degrades gracefully
cases.oracle: clean load without dev bundle

cases.scenario: At 80x24 REPL remains editable, inspector collapses, popup clips safely
cases.oracle: full screen capture and key echo

cases.scenario: At 120x40 REPL/inspector split, popup and docs anchored correctly
cases.oracle: frame cells and focus assertions

cases.scenario: At 160x50 panes and long docs reflow with no truncated cursor
cases.oracle: screen capture after resize

cases.scenario: Repeated 80x24 -> 160x50 -> 120x40 resize preserves editor text and selection
cases.oracle: snapshot geometry and text

cases.scenario: Normal exit, error, interrupt and repeated launch restore termios and cursor
cases.oracle: before/after stty -g and terminal state capture

cases.scenario: Idle frame does not cause uncontrolled repaint or CPU spin
cases.oracle: PTY output byte count after idle and bounded CPU evidence

cases.scenario: Optional ASDF system compiles and startup emits no new compiler warnings
cases.oracle: CLPM SBCL compile transcript and exit code

cases.scenario: Passive syntax inspection never executes #. reader evaluation or arbitrary highlighted forms
cases.oracle: sentinel side-effect remains untouched

cases.scenario: Local mode does not open a TCP listener; remote Slynk requires explicit request
cases.oracle: port/listener and dependency check
